_about: Hand-kept inputs for build-sprout-map.py: things no registry holds (entry points, web surfaces, tab placement, which sections belong to which feature, cross-feature handoffs, surface edges, open questions). Paths are relative to ~/Sprout. Statuses use DESIGN-LABELS.md values only (Design: Unverified / In review / Approved; Handoff: Not recorded / Drafted / Sent / Received; Release: Unverified / In development / Shipped) and every non-default value carries its evidence. The figma_snapshot block is written by `build-sprout-map.py import-figma`; do not hand-edit it.

entries.label: App Store / Google Play
entries.what: A parent finds Sprout in the store and installs it. The store set (V.11) is the listing they see.

entries.label: Invite or referral link
entries.what: A friend's unique link opens the web Invited by page: phone, code, registered, then download. The deferred deep link puts the new parent into the inviter's class.

entries.label: Class group chat link
entries.what: A room parent shares the class chat link. The web page verifies the phone number, registers the parent and makes downloading Sprout the next step.
entries.open: Production URL is unsettled: README says roomparent.com/chat/<classId>, spec/24 (14 Oct) says the link stays on joinsprout.co with the new flow on /chat.

entries.label: Spouse invite SMS
entries.sub: Sent from the parent's own phone
entries.what: The first parent texts their spouse from Messages. The spouse installs Sprout and goes through spouse onboarding. A spouse already on Sprout gets a push and accepts instead (17 Oct).

entries.label: Push notification
entries.what: A push opens the app at the right place: the morning push opens the Daily Brief, an Assist suggestion opens Assist, a message opens Chat.

entries.label: In-app group invitation
entries.sub: Join a school group or club
